name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JANUARY 10, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Avery, Olvera, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of December 13, 2018
7
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Parcel Map 74998
Bouma USA, Applicant
A request to subdivide one lot totaling approximately 36 acres into two lots totaling approximately 22 acres and approximately 14 acres located at the southeast corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 35th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 74998 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 18-016
Lusine Mkrtchian, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 (On-sale Beer and Wine) alcoholic beverage control license at a bona fide restaurant (Olive’s Mediterranean Cafe) located at 1125 West Rancho Vista Boulevard, Suite C.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 18-016 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit 16-011 Minor Modification No. 2
Mr. Kamal Al-Khatib, Applicant
A request to modify the phasing of the proposed charter school as approved through CUP 16-011 and Major Modification (MM) No.1 located at 3838 East Avenue R.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-003 approving Conditional Use Permit 16-011 Major Modification No. 2 and find that the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration adequately addresses the phasing for the project, as outlined within the Addendum. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Conditional Use Permit 18-006
Krishna Swamy, Applicant
A request to legalize an existing motel use (Palm Motel) located at 38536 6th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit 18-006 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, February 14, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
